correctness.rationale: Semantics give N_(j+1)=pre(P_j), P_j={w:R(w) subset N_j}. A minimal-index contradiction proves every N_i disjoint from every P_j; a separator in N_(m+1)\N_m forces m+1 distinct new N layers and m+1 distinct new P layers. Equality gives unique roles a_i,b_j and the exact necessary-and-sufficient arc constraints; each optional edge can be chosen independently, yielding E_m=(m+1)^2+m^2. A path gives the matching upper bound. The checker exhaustively tests all relations on <=4 worlds, all canonical m<=2 patterns, and additional boundary cases, returning ALL_CHECKS_OK. Infinite quantification is discharged by the written proof, not finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The motivating paper explicitly presents the modal mirage family and a missing all-m minimality guarantee. The result supplies that guarantee and an exact structural classification: every minimum frame is forced to contain a spanning path, is rigid, and has an exact binomial edge census, with 2^(2m^2+2m+1) natural isomorphism classes. The count measures all optimal witnesses, rather than a contrived parameter slice or another isolated small example.
